name: Rohit Udaiwal
title: AI Engineer

bullets.label: Knowledge Graphs & Clinical Trial Eligibility
bullets.text: Building knowledge graphs for clinical trial eligibility screening using a funnel-based approach: filtering patients criterion by criterion through structured Cypher queries and narrative queries over patient medical records to answer clinical eligibility questions.

bullets.label: RPA & Portal Integration
bullets.text: Engineered payer-portal workflows for US healthcare pharmacy prior authorization (PA), eliminating up to 60% of manual form submissions and progressing toward no-touch PA submissions.

bullets.label: Medical Necessity Agent
bullets.text: Built an agent that reasons over clinical charts against medical-necessity criteria to answer PA questionnaires and predict approval likelihood, using MCP tools for CMS/OpenFDA and a custom PA skill on the Claude Agent SDK.

bullets.label: PA Status Voice Agent
bullets.text: Built a voice agent to retrieve real-time PA status from PBMs through tool calls, with IVR navigation, live call listening, human takeover, and real-time status updates.

bullets.label: Intelligent Customer Support
bullets.text: Developed a centralized support chatbot using Flask, LangChain, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol to route queries by request type.

bullets.label: Transaction Classification
bullets.text: Worked on a bank-statement narration classifier using Quarkus, React, Next.js, LLMs, BERT-based NLP, and vLLM for personal finance and lending decisions.

bullets.label: Financial AI
bullets.text: Led development of machine learning solutions using NLP and large language models for real-time transaction analysis and financial decision-making.

bullets.label: Scalable Data Pipelines
bullets.text: Developed 50+ multi-region data pipelines to collect, process, and store diverse datasets in the central Wealth Management data lake.

bullets.label: Modernization
bullets.text: Built data-processing workflows with Python, PySpark, Spring Boot, AWS, and Docker; created an enterprise Spring Boot application adopted by 100+ teams.

bullets.label: CI/CD Automation
bullets.text: Developed Jenkins and Docker CI/CD pipelines that reduced deployment times by 70%.
